findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - A maintainer moves the all-attempts filter into a GraphQL variable set to `ALL`. GitHub accepts that equivalent request, but this regex sees no literal `checkType: ALL` and the fake drops earlier attempts, making the runner-minute assertion fail despite unchanged behavior. [GitHub documents variables for query arguments](https://docs.github.com/en/graphql/guides/forming-calls-with-graphql#working-with-variables). The fake also supplies `oid` even if the query omits it, so the cancelled-timeout test can pass while the real report cannot identify the timeout. The previously raised test gate therefore remains open.
